description: Implementation of the OpenMaxComponentBase class for managing OpenMax components on Raspberry Pi, including initialization, handle management, event handling, and command synchronization.

classes.name: OpenMaxComponentBase
classes.description: Class managing OpenMax component lifecycle, event handling, and command synchronization on Raspberry Pi.

methods.name: OpenMaxComponentBase
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the OpenMax component, retrieves ports, and disables them.

methods.name: ~OpenMaxComponentBase
methods.description: Destructor that frees the OpenMax handle.

methods.name: SendCommand
methods.description: Sends a command to the OpenMax component.

methods.name: WaitForCommandCompletion
methods.description: Waits for the completion of a previously sent command.

methods.name: SendCommandAndWaitForCompletion
methods.description: Sends a command and waits for its completion.

methods.name: OnEvent
methods.description: Handles OpenMax events such as errors and port setting changes.
